item.title: Weekly Market Outlook — Week of May 4, 2026
item.description: Soft-landing narrative meets sticky inflation, a concentrated AI rally, and an increasingly structural geopolitical tape. Ideas into payrolls, ISM Services, and JOLTS — plus four sector calls and four macro options structures.

item.title: The Fed After Powell
item.description: Notes on the April 29 FOMC meeting. The market is watching the rate path; the more differentiated story is the institution. Powell stays on the Board, four dissents, Warsh advances toward confirmation, and the under-priced risk shows up in term premium rather than the front-end policy path.
